entities.summary: Yin Wen was a Chinese philosopher and logician associated with the School of Names during the Warring States period. He is associated with the text Yin Wenzi (尹文子) and is mentioned in many philosophically adjacent texts; his ideas would heavily influence those of Gongsun Long.
